name: Arbalest

frame.name: Compounding Force
frame.description: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.description: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: "We didn't have linear fusions in the Dark Age. But we made it work." —The Drifter

catalyst.name: Arbalest Catalyst
catalyst.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.
